messages:
Nina (People Ops): Putting a short manager+HR handoff thread for Dev's new hire (Riley) starting Mon — keeping it actionable so IT and buddy can run overnight.

Pre-day checklist (today):
- Confirm legal name + preferred display name (Dev).
- Upload ID to HR portal (Riley).
- Device assignment: Jordan to confirm laptop model & pickup method.
- Add Riley to: #product, #pm, #new-hires, dev mailing lists.
- Create OnboardBot checklist and tag Kai as buddy.

Day 1 quick schedule (keep unbusy):
- 09:30: Security + HR admin (Jordan / Nina) 
- 11:00: Team intros (15m) — no slides, round-robin.
- 13:00: Product context + metrics tour (Kai)
- 15:00: 1:1 with Dev (30m) — set top priorities and communication norms.
- Assign a micro task: pick one user flow and write a <1 page summary of friction points.

Week 1 must-dos:
- SSO, MFA, and required trainings done.
- Read last three sprint PRDs and one customer convo.
- Shadow a support rotation or product demo.
- Draft 3 hypotheses for 30-day impact.

30/60/90 prompts (paste into 1:1):
- 30d: Understand users, own a small spec, identify 3 quick wins.
- 60d: Run an experiment, gather metrics, iterate.
- 90d: Drive a measurable improvement and propose next hires/process changes.

Logistics & links:
- HR portal: https://hr.redwood.local/onboard (Nina)
- Console access form: /forms/console-access (Dev pls include GitHub handle)
- Onboard checklist: OB-1735557777 (OnboardBot)

Dev (Eng Manager): I'll send a short intro email to the team now and include GitHub handle. Kai confirmed buddy slot at 13:00. Can we block 30m on day 2 to hand off the micro-task?

Nina (People Ops): Done — OnboardBot checklist created and Kai added as buddy. Reminder kicks at day 3 and day 7.

Jordan (IT): Laptop (13" MBP) imaged. Pickup at security 09:00 or courier option available. Need phone for MFA or we can issue a hardware key. Riley, DM me your preference.

Kai (Product Buddy): Will show dashboard, backlog, and one customer ticket during the product tour. Suggest we add a quick doc template for the 1-page summary so others can reuse it.

Dev (Eng Manager): Blocking day 2 14:00 for micro-task handoff. Also adding Riley to oncall-docs read-only; DevOps (Sam) to grant access after GitHub handle.

Riley (new PM): Thanks everyone! Quick Q: preferred format for the 1-page?

Kai (Product Buddy): Bulleted findings, short root cause, and 3 suggested next steps is perfect. Share in #product and attach to the OnboardBot checklist.

OnboardBot: Created checklist OB-1735557777 and scheduled reminders. Link: https://onboard.redwood.local/checklist/OB-1735557777

Nina (People Ops): Closing pre-day items — reply if anything changes overnight. :smile:
